_comment: Rank Math SEO MCP template (one server per WordPress site). Rank Math exposes rank-math/* abilities through the WordPress MCP Adapter default server. Generate a site-specific entry with: wordpress-mcp-helper.sh rankmath-config <site> <url> <user> <secret-name> [opencode|claude|json]
_setup: aidevops secret set RANKMATH_EXAMPLE_WP_APP_PASSWORD && ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/wordpress-mcp-helper.sh rankmath-check https://example.com aidevops-bot RANKMATH_EXAMPLE_WP_APP_PASSWORD
_env: No secrets in this file. serve-http resolves the Application Password named by the last argument from the environment/credentials.sh or aidevops secret at launch.

rankmath-example._comment: Disabled by default; enable per session or via the rankmath-mcp subagent (tools: rankmath-*). Replace /Users/YOU with your home directory.

claude_desktop_oauth._comment: Vendor-recommended for Claude Desktop/claude.ai: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector. Approve in WordPress; revoke via the generated Application Password.
